decisions.title: pilot-isolation
decisions.summary: Pilot is metadata/verification only; preserve merged PR #11 runtime and all other workstreams.

rules.title: authority-chain
rules.summary: Website owns acquisition/lead truth. ONE owns customer/SaaS/billing truth. Mobile is a consumer of versioned ONE APIs, never customer or payment truth.

rules.title: no-release
rules.summary: No self-approval, self-merge, production mutation, secret storage or external release. Evidence types are not interchangeable.

anti_patterns.title: synthetic-proof-promotion
anti_patterns.summary: Do not promote synthetic fixtures, debug APKs, successful SDK initialization or producer-only proof into hosted Mobile E2E, device, payment or release evidence.
